title: Concept: Cargo lockfile entry without a checksum
description: Cargo.lock declares a locked crate that records no checksum, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Cargo cannot verify the downloaded crate against the lockfile, so a mirror can serve different bytes for the same version.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Cargo.lock (cargo).
risk: Cargo cannot verify the downloaded crate against the lockfile, so a mirror can serve different bytes for the same version.
